ayahs.en: O you who covers himself [with a garment]
ayahs.e2: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺

ayahs.en: Arise and warn
ayahs.e2: Arise and warn ˹all˺

ayahs.en: And your Lord glorify
ayahs.e2: Revere your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.en: And your clothing purify
ayahs.e2: Purify your garments

ayahs.en: And uncleanliness avoid
ayahs.e2: ˹Continue to˺ shun idols

ayahs.en: And do not confer favor to acquire more
ayahs.e2: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺

ayahs.en: But for your Lord be patient
ayahs.e2: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord

ayahs.en: And when the trumpet is blown
ayahs.e2: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded

ayahs.en: That Day will be a difficult day
ayahs.e2: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—

ayahs.en: For the disbelievers - not easy
ayahs.e2: far from easy for the disbelievers

ayahs.en: Leave Me with the one I created alone
ayahs.e2: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself

ayahs.en: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
ayahs.e2: and granted him abundant wealth

ayahs.en: And children present [with him]
ayahs.e2: and children always by his side

ayahs.en: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life]
ayahs.e2: and made life very easy for him

ayahs.en: Then he desires that I should add more
ayahs.e2: Yet he is hungry for more

ayahs.en: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate
ayahs.e2: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations

ayahs.en: I will cover him with arduous torment
ayahs.e2: I will make his fate unbearable

ayahs.en: Indeed, he thought and deliberated
ayahs.e2: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺

ayahs.en: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated
ayahs.e2: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined

ayahs.en: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated
ayahs.e2: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined

ayahs.en: Then he considered [again]
ayahs.e2: Then he re-contemplated ˹in frustration˺

ayahs.en: Then he frowned and scowled
ayahs.e2: then frowned and scowled

ayahs.en: Then he turned back and was arrogant
ayahs.e2: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ يُؤۡثَرُ
ayahs.en: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others]
ayahs.e2: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients
ayahs.tr: Faqaala in haazaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar

ayahs.en: This is not but the word of a human being
ayahs.e2: This is no more than the word of a man.”

ayahs.en: I will drive him into Saqar
ayahs.e2: Soon I will burn him in Hell

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is Saqar
ayahs.e2: And what will make you realize what Hell is

ayahs.en: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned]
ayahs.e2: It does not let anyone live or die

ayahs.en: Blackening the skins
ayahs.e2: scorching the skin

ayahs.en: Over it are nineteen [angels]
ayahs.e2: It is overseen by nineteen ˹keepers˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ
ayahs.en: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity
ayahs.e2: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity
ayahs.tr: Wa maaja''alnaaa As haaban naari illaa malaaa 'ikatanw wa maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo liyastayqinal lazeena ootul kitaaba wa yazdaadal lazeena aamanooo eemaananw wa laa yartaabal lazeena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona wa liyaqoolal lazeena fee quloo bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu many yashaaa'u wa yahdee many yashaaa'; wa maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; wa maa hiya illaa zikraa lil bashar

ayahs.en: No! By the moon
ayahs.e2: But no! By the moon

ayahs.en: And [by] the night when it departs
ayahs.e2: and the night as it retreats

ayahs.en: And [by] the morning when it brightens
ayahs.e2: and the day as it breaks

ayahs.en: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
ayahs.e2: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—

ayahs.en: As a warning to humanity
ayahs.e2: a warning to humankind

ayahs.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.en: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind
ayahs.e2: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind
ayahs.tr: Liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata akhkhar

ayahs.en: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
ayahs.e2: Every soul will be detained for what it has done

ayahs.en: Except the companions of the right
ayahs.e2: except the people of the right

ayahs.en: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
ayahs.e2: who will be in Gardens, asking one another

ayahs.en: About the criminals
ayahs.e2: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺

ayahs.en: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar
ayahs.e2: “What has landed you in Hell?”

ayahs.en: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed
ayahs.e2: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed

ayahs.en: Nor did we used to feed the poor
ayahs.e2: nor did we feed the poor

ayahs.en: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it]
ayahs.e2: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others

ayahs.en: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.e2: and deny the Day of Judgment
ayahs.tr: Wa kunnaa nukazzibu bi yawmid Deen

ayahs.en: Until there came to us the certainty
ayahs.e2: until the inevitable came to us.”

ayahs.en: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors
ayahs.e2: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them

ayahs.en: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
ayahs.e2: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder

ayahs.en: As if they were alarmed donkeys
ayahs.e2: as if they were spooked zebras

ayahs.en: Fleeing from a lion
ayahs.e2: fleeing from a lion

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفࣰا مُّنَشَّرَةࣰ
ayahs.en: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about
ayahs.e2: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺
ayahs.tr: Bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah

ayahs.en: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter
ayahs.e2: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter

ayahs.en: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
ayahs.e2: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder

ayahs.en: Then whoever wills will remember it
ayahs.e2: So let whoever wills be mindful of it

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ
ayahs.en: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness
ayahs.e2: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive
ayahs.tr: Wa maa yazkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; Huwa ahlut taqwaa wa ahlul maghfirah
